title: 第309章 不成功便成仁第308章 两种结局
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
灵泉对面，琴芯静静听着她的分析，清冷的眉眼间寒意层层叠加，淡漠的脸庞看不出多余情绪，唯有眼底深处的焦灼愈发浓烈。
沉默片刻，琴芯才缓缓开口，音色清冷素雅，声线平直克制，听不出太多情绪，却字字精准，直击要害。
“这些年，你大师姐常年蛰伏在陈国丰隆郡，从不轻易走动。按照以往的羁绊与交情推算，我那大师姐柳虹，必然也一直藏身于丰隆郡一带，与她互为依仗、彼此照应。”
她抬眸看向靳墨，眼神凝重：“只是如今局势大变，我尚且无法确定，柳虹此刻是否也顺利突破，踏入了三品明镜境。”
靳墨微微摇头，妩媚的眉眼间带着一丝通透的笃定，语气平缓回应：“应当没有……”
“你是青禾族的圣女，族人突破高阶境界，你必然会得到天地道韵感应，心生异动……”靳墨缓缓拆解局势，条理清晰，“你至今毫无感应，便说明柳虹的修为，依旧卡在三品玄通境，尚未突破……”
“嗯……”琴芯轻轻颔首，动作轻柔幅度不大，胸前饱满丰盈的双峰随着这轻微的动作微微颤动，弧度优美诱人，在朦胧灵雾与澄澈泉水的映衬下，愈发惹眼。
她清冷的嗓音带着一丝难以察觉的凝重：“可云韵已然成功突破，稳稳立足三品明镜境。以柳虹的心性与天赋，再有云韵铺路参照，她距离突破，已然不远了……”
“是啊……”靳墨轻轻叹息一声，眼底的妖娆尽数褪去，只剩沉沉的忧虑与不甘。
“你我二人联手，篡夺圣女之位，执掌赤鲤、青禾两族大权，整整十五年。十五年安稳蛰伏，看似权柄在握、风光无限，如今看来，这安稳日子，怕是快要到头了……”
此话一出，洞内气氛愈发压抑。
琴芯沉默片刻，清冷的眼底闪过一丝狠厉，瞬间打破了消极的氛围，语气沉稳坚定，带着破局的决绝。
“不必这般悲观……”
“早前陈国丰隆郡陨落的两位二品人仙境高人，你应当还有印象……”琴芯眸光锐利，缓缓道出自己的判断，“事后我仔细查证推演，基本可以确定，其中一人，便是当年出手、从你我手中救下云韵与柳虹的人……”
“如今此人已然陨落，彻底消亡……”琴芯语气愈发笃定，“云韵、柳虹二人身边，再无二品修士坐镇，哪怕她们二人尽数突破至三品明镜境，修为精进，你我依旧有翻盘的机会，并非全无胜算……”
靳墨闻言，妖娆的眼眸骤然一亮，抬眸直直看向对面的琴芯。
相交数十年，她最是了解琴芯的心思，仅仅一句提点，便瞬间洞悉了对方暗藏的盘算，眼底闪过一丝讶异，随即涌上浓烈的战意。
“你的意思是……主动出手？”
“嗯……”
琴芯重重点头，这一次动作幅度稍大，胸前丰盈的身姿轻轻震颤，撩人至极。

她清冷的面容上褪去所有柔和，只剩决绝与狠厉，平日里闷骚内敛的性子，在关乎权柄与生死的大局面前，彻底展露锋芒。
“不成功，便成仁……”
她字字清晰，语气冰冷坚定，毫无半分迟疑：“你我心中都清楚真相。这些年来，云韵、柳虹二人一直潜藏在陈国境内，隐忍不出、避世修行，根本原因只有一个——她们的修为常年被困在三品玄通境，不足以撼动你我的地位，不足以翻盘夺权。”
“可一旦她们彻底突破桎梏，踏入三品明镜境，修为赶超你我，掌控了足够的力量，必然会第一时间折返南疆，清算当年旧账，夺回本该属于她们的圣女权位……”
“与其坐以待毙，等她们修为大成、归来夺权，将你我打入万劫不复之地，不如主动出击，抢先破局……”琴芯目光沉沉，透着极致的冷静与野心，“若是等她们返回渊国南疆，你我十五年的掌权基业，将彻底崩塌，再无翻身可能……”
“说得没错！”靳墨眸光一凛，眼底的忧虑尽数化作凌厉的战意，瞬间收敛盘膝的坐姿，腰身一挺，整个人缓缓从温热的灵泉之中站起身来。
她通体赤裸，无半点遮掩，丰腴饱满的娇躯彻底暴露在洞内朦胧的灵光与水雾之中。
起身的刹那，胸前饱满圆润的双峰微微震颤，线条优美流畅，纤细柔韧的腰肢紧致窈窕，挺翘的臀线弧度完美，一双双腿笔直匀称、白皙修长，浑身肌理细腻如雪，每一寸曲线都极尽妩媚撩人，天生的妖娆身段在微光下尽显风情。
青色灵力依旧萦绕周身，轻轻贴合肌肤，衬得她肌肤愈发莹润透亮，媚态入骨，张力十足。
靳墨抬眸望向对面依旧静坐的琴芯，眼底慵懒尽数褪去，只剩孤注一掷的决绝。
“被动等待，必死无疑……唯有主动出击，殊死一搏，你我才有一线生机，守住这十五年的权柄基业……”
话音落定，洞内凝滞的气氛再次一动。
琴芯望着眼前战意凛然的靳墨，清冷的眼底最后一丝犹豫彻底散去，取而代之的是同等决绝的狠厉。
她缓缓颔首，脖颈纤细优美，动作不急不缓，相较于靳墨骤然起身的凌厉，她的姿态依旧带着与生俱来的清冷自持，却藏着破釜沉舟的坚定。
“没错……”简单两字落下，琴芯腰身轻轻一挺，顺着温热的泉水浮力，缓缓站起身来。
她通体赤裸，无半分衣衫遮掩，常年修行沉淀的丰盈身段全然展露在朦胧灵雾与莹白灵光之中。
肌肤莹润通透，肌理细腻无瑕，没有丝毫瑕疵，饱满圆润的前胸随着起身的动作微微起伏震颤，弧度柔和优美，极具风情。
纤细紧致的腰肢不盈一握，挺翘流畅的臀线勾勒出极致曼妙的身段曲线，修长笔直的双腿匀称白皙，骨肉配比恰到好处，每一寸线条都生得极尽完美。
清冷绝尘的面容，搭配这般妩媚丰盈的惹火身段，极致的反差格外勾人。
content_en:
Opposite Lingquan, Qin Xin listened to her analysis quietly, with layers of coldness between her cold brows and eyes. There was no extra emotion on her indifferent face, only the anxiety deep in her eyes became more intense.
After a moment of silence, Qin Xin slowly spoke. His tone was cold and elegant, his voice was straight and restrained. There was not much emotion to be heard, but every word was precise and hit the point.
"In these years, your senior sister has been dormant in Fenglong County of Chen State all year round and never moves around easily. According to the past bonds and friendships, my senior sister Liu Hong must have been hiding in Fenglong County, and we rely on each other and take care of each other."
She raised her eyes and looked at Jin Mo with solemn eyes: "It's just that the situation has changed drastically now. I'm still not sure whether Liu Hong has successfully broken through and entered the third-grade mirror realm."
Jin Mo shook his head slightly, with a hint of determination in his charming eyebrows, and responded in a calm tone: "Probably not..."
"You are a saint of the Qinghe tribe. If your tribe breaks through to high-level realms, you will inevitably be affected by the rhythm of heaven and earth, and your heart will change..." Jin Mo slowly broke down the situation with clear logic, "You still haven't felt anything yet, which means that Liu Hong's cultivation is still stuck in the third-grade Xuantong realm and has not yet broken through..."
"Hmm..." Qin Xin nodded gently, with a gentle and moderate movement. The plump and plump breasts on his chest trembled slightly with this slight movement. The arcs were beautiful and attractive, and they became even more eye-catching against the backdrop of the hazy spiritual mist and clear spring water.
Her cold voice carried a hint of imperceptible solemnity: "But Yunyun has successfully broken through and firmly established herself in the third-grade mirror realm. With Liu Hong's character and talent, and with Yun Yun paving the way for reference, she is not far away from breaking through..."
"Yeah..." Jin Mo sighed softly, and all the enchantment in his eyes faded away, leaving only deep worry and unwillingness.
"You and I have joined forces to usurp the position of the Saint and take charge of the Red Carp and Qinghe clans for fifteen years. We have been dormant for fifteen years, seemingly in control and with unlimited glory. Now it seems that these stable days are coming to an end..."
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere in the cave became more and more depressing.
Qin Xin was silent for a moment, and a fierce look flashed in his cold eyes, instantly breaking the negative atmosphere. His tone was calm and firm, with the determination to break the situation.
"No need to be so pessimistic..."
"You should still have an impression of the two second-level immortal realm experts who died in Chen Guofenglong County earlier..." Qin Xin's eyes were sharp and he slowly expressed his judgment, "Afterwards, I carefully verified and deduced, and I can basically confirm that one of them was the person who rescued Yun Yun and Liu Hong from you and me..."
"Now this person has fallen and died completely..." Qin Xin's tone became more and more determined, "There are no second-grade monks around Yun Yun and Liu Hong. Even if they break through to the third-grade mirror realm and improve their cultivation, you and I still have a chance to make a comeback. It is not completely impossible to win..."
When Jin Mo heard this, his enchanting eyes suddenly lit up, and he raised his eyes and looked straight at Qin Xin opposite.
After having known each other for decades, she understood Qin Xin's thoughts best. With just a few words of advice, she instantly understood the other party's hidden plans. A trace of surprise flashed in her eyes, and then a strong fighting spirit surged into her eyes.
"You mean... take the initiative?"
"Well..."
Qin Xin nodded heavily, this time the movement range was slightly larger, and the plump figure on her chest trembled slightly, which was extremely sultry.
All softness had faded from her cold face, leaving only determination and fierceness. Her usually dull and reserved temperament completely showed its edge in the face of a big situation involving power and life and death.
"If you don't succeed, you will succeed..."
Her words were clear and her tone was cold and firm, without any hesitation: "You and I both know the truth. Over the years, Yun Yun and Liu Hong have been hiding in the Chen Kingdom, hiding themselves from the world and practicing cultivation. There is only one fundamental reason - their cultivation has been trapped in the third-level Xuantong realm all year round, which is not enough to shake your and my status, and it is not enough to come back and seize power."
"But once theyCompletely breaking through the shackles, stepping into the third-level mirror realm, surpassing you and me in cultivation, and controlling enough power, they will inevitably return to the southern border as soon as possible, settle the old accounts, and regain the power of the saint that should belong to them..."
"Rather than just waiting to die, waiting for them to return to the southern border of Yuan Kingdom and seize power, and throw you and me into a place of eternal destruction, it is better to take the initiative and break the situation first..." Qin Xin's eyes were heavy, showing the ultimate calmness and ambition, "If we wait for them to return to the southern border of Yuan Kingdom, the foundation of your fifteen years of power will completely collapse, and there will be no possibility of turning around..."
"You're right! "Jin Mo's eyes flashed, and all the worries in his eyes turned into fierce fighting spirit. He instantly stopped sitting cross-legged, straightened his waist, and slowly stood up from the warm spiritual spring.
She was completely naked, without any covering, and her plump and plump body was completely exposed to the hazy spiritual light and mist in the cave.
The moment she stood up, the plump and round peaks on her chest trembled slightly, with graceful and smooth lines, her slender and flexible waist was tight and graceful, her hips were perfectly curved, her legs were straight and well-proportioned, white and slender, her body texture was as delicate as snow, every inch of her curves were extremely charming, and her naturally enchanting figure showed off her charm in the dim light.
The cyan spiritual power still lingered around her body, gently adhering to her skin, making her skin more moist and translucent, charming and full of tension.
Jin Mo raised his eyes to look at Qin Xin, who was still sitting quietly across from him. All the laziness in his eyes faded away, leaving only desperate determination.
"Waiting passively will lead to certain death...Only by taking the initiative and fighting to the death can you and I have a chance to hold on to our fifteen-year power and foundation..."
After the words were settled, the stagnant atmosphere in the cave stirred again.
Qin Xin looked at Jin Mo who was full of fighting spirit in front of him, and the last trace of hesitation in his cold eyes completely disappeared, replaced by the same determination and severity.
She nodded slowly, her neck was slender and graceful, and her movements were neither hasty nor slow. Compared to Jin Mo's sudden and sharp rise, her posture still had an innate coolness and self-possession, but it hid the determination of breaking the cauldron.
"That's right..." After saying these two simple words, Qin Xin straightened his waist slightly and slowly stood up following the buoyancy of the warm spring water.
She was completely naked, with no clothes to cover her body, and her plump figure accumulated through years of practice was completely exposed in the hazy spiritual mist and crystal white spiritual light.
The skin is moist and translucent, the texture is delicate and flawless, and there is no flaw at all. The plump and round chest undulates and trembles slightly with the movement of standing up, and the arc is soft and graceful, which is very charming.
The slender and tight waist is not too tight to hold, the straight and smooth hip line outlines the extremely graceful body curve, the slender and straight legs are well-proportioned and fair, the proportion of bone and flesh is just right, and every inch of the line is perfectly formed.
The perfect contrast between the cold and pure face and such a charming and plump figure is particularly alluring.
